prompt:
Image 1 shows 2 animation frames of a chibi game character side by side (2 equal tall cells, left then right) taken from a soft video clip. Redraw EXACTLY the same 2 frames at full resolution, side by side in 2 equal cells: in every cell the same pose, the same limb and weapon angles, the same size and the same position inside the cell as Image 1, and the same shape and position of the hair, braid, scarf, cape, tail and every loose cloth piece, because the cells play as one smooth animation. Same camera distance in all cells. No borders between cells. Nothing crosses a cell edge.
Image 2 is the approved crisp drawing of the same character at rest: copy her exact face, eyes, hair colour, ears, costume, every armour piece and ornament, weapon design, tail and colours from Image 2 into every cell, while each cell keeps the pose of Image 1. Take only the rendering and the design details from Image 2, never its pose.
Where an arm, hand or weapon passes in front of the face or hair, draw each part clearly separated (glove, sleeve, hair, face), never melt them into a smudge or a distorted face.
Do not redesign, add or remove anything; no extra weapon, no extra hands. Keep any drawn effect that is already there.
Redraw it as a crisp, high-resolution finished game illustration with clean sharp dark outlines, fine readable detail in hair strands, cloth folds and metal, rich saturated colours and clear highlights. No blur, no motion smear, no soft focus, no pixelation. Both cells must look like the same drawing: identical line weight, colours and details.
Background 100% solid flat magenta #FF00FF. No gradients in the background, no text, no labels, no shadow on the ground.
She holds ONE rigid crescent glaive: where the source frame shows a motion-blur ghost or double outline of the blade or shaft (while she lowers it), draw only one clean glaive with one continuous shaft in her hand, never a second blade. Draw both legs separately and clearly, each knee and boot readable, even where the source legs overlap or smear.

precheck.summary: The candidate shows two side-by-side cells on a flat magenta background, with one character per cell, a single glaive, no visible text or extra figures, and nothing cut off by the cell or image edges. The pose and costume broadly match the references. The legs in the right cell are slightly soft, but this is stylistic drift rather than a clear defect.
